description: TN-38 is the Regional Transport Office for Coimbatore North, responsible for overseeing motor vehicle registrations and licensing in the northern suburbs of the city. It plays a crucial role in managing the heavy vehicular traffic and transport administration for one of Tamil Nadu's largest industrial hubs.
address: No. 337, Vellakinar Road, Near CTC Colony, Thudiyalur, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu
